description: Every model file the film-analysis worker loads. Files live in tools/models/ (git-ignored, copied or downloaded from source_url); this manifest is committed. 'path' is relative to tools/models/. The worker refuses a model whose size differs and verifies sha256 with --verify-models. 'upstream_check' says how the hash was compared with the publisher's own record on 2026-10-12.

models.role: shot boundaries: per-frame probability that a cut lies between this frame and the next (single-frame head) and that the frame is inside a transition (many-hot head)
models.origin: third-party ONNX re-export (release transnetv2-v1, 2026-06-01) of soCzech/TransNetV2 weights (commit 85cef72a); exporter's own parity record: probabilities differ from TensorFlow by at most 1.3e-7
models.upstream_check: sha256 equals the GitHub release asset digest
models.license_note: upstream soCzech/TransNetV2 is MIT; the re-export repository itself carries no licence file. Re-export from upstream ourselves before shipping.

io.input: frames uint8 [1,100,27,48,3] RGB 0-255 (normalisation is inside the graph)

models.origin: deepghs/anime_face_detection, directory face_detect_v1.4_s (newest face model in the repository; repository last modified 2024-09-24)
models.upstream_check: sha256 equals the Hugging Face LFS oid
models.license_note: weights are MIT; the network is a YOLOv8-class architecture (Ultralytics code is AGPL-3.0): matters when the project licence is chosen

outputs: [B,5,N] cx, cy, w, h, score; NMS IoU 0.7

models.origin: deepghs/anime_head_detection, directory head_detect_v2.0_s_yv11 (the repository also has larger v2.0 models m, l, x; last modified 2024-10-19)
models.upstream_check: sha256 equals the Hugging Face LFS oid
models.license_note: weights are MIT; YOLO11-class architecture (Ultralytics code is AGPL-3.0)

outputs: [B,5,N] cx, cy, w, h, score; NMS IoU 0.7

models.origin: deepghs/anime_person_detection, directory person_detect_v1.3_s (newest person model in the repository; last modified 2024-09-24)
models.upstream_check: sha256 equals the Hugging Face LFS oid
models.license_note: weights are MIT; YOLOv8-class architecture (Ultralytics code is AGPL-3.0)

outputs: [B,5,N] cx, cy, w, h, score; NMS IoU 0.7

models.role: faces in live action (class face), run through OpenCV's FaceDetectorYN on the CPU
models.origin: opencv/opencv_zoo, models/face_detection_yunet (repository pushed 2026-05-28); the newer face_detection_yunet_2026may.onnx is the same network with dynamic input size, not used because the measured runs used 2023mar with setInputSize
models.upstream_check: sha256 equals the oid in the Git LFS pointer
models.license_note: YuNet is MIT (Shiqi Yu); copy of the licence text in tools/models/yunet-2023mar/LICENSE

io.input: cv2.FaceDetectorYN, BGR image at its own size (setInputSize)
outputs: x, y, w, h, five landmarks, score

not_included.reason: PyTorch-only second opinion for shot types; the worker's hot path is ONNX only. Add it behind the same boundary table later if the shot bake-off asks for it.
